_about: Provenance and Contamination Ledger (Core BF-10, Companion 24.7 and Part 69): for each recorded provision, its historical origin and the Originator's degree -- ORIGINATED, DIRECTED, EDITED or ADOPTED. Filled where practicable from 17 October 2026; an origin not recorded stays UNKNOWN and is never inferred. Provenance records origin; it does not decide validity.
